citations.narrative:
Some areas were in need of repair:
-The fence dividing the Barbado and wool sheep had a gap large enough that the sheep could possibly get in with each
other.
-The shelters in the Barbado sheep pen has a rusted and rough edge on it.
Rough edges and fence gaps could cause injury to animals. Ensure to maintain housing facilities in good repair to protect
the animals from injury and to contain the animals.

Areas around the drinking bowls for the Highlander cows' and Barbado sheep's pens lacked adequate drainage. Animals
in these pens would have to walk and stand in mud to get to their drinking water. Lack of adequate drainage around
drinking bowls could cause discomfort and hoof health problems in animals. Ensure that animal housing areas have a
suitable method to rapidly eliminate excess water.
***Correct by Sept 19, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
